# Belinda & Nell Harcourt

- [Belinda](../character/belinda.md) — Friend of — [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — close friends · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 ch.Revelation P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to teaching school, where [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) reports his classroom antics while [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is terrified by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories of family ghosts. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde take a wrong turn while walking through the autumn woods to a tea invitation and discover [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), where its owner, Miss Rosalind [Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), invites them to stay for tea.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P16](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0016), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> Miss Rosalind welcomes Isolde and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) for tea at [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) and explains her solitary life, imaginative habits, and why her young helper is called Belinda the Fourth. When [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) Stanhope's name is mentioned, Miss Rosalind asks if he is [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) Stanhope's son before growing quiet and distant. As the girls walk away, they reflect on her loneliness and the meaning of names.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Rosalind P84](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0084)_

> After recounting a story about losing and finding streetcar fare, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde visit [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) for a day outing. They open the house, reminisce about [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), test the echoes with an old horn, and head home after sunset.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P57](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0057), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.Again P59](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0059), [v3 ch.Again P60](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0060)_
